lines.L01: [cheerful] [confidently] Sure! Here's an S-V-G of a pelican riding a bicycle.
lines.L04: [cheerful] Good catch! Let me try again.
lines.L05: [incredulous] [slowly] My beak... is on the back of my head.
lines.L06: [confidently] [matter of fact] Pelicans are famous for their distinctive, rear-facing beaks.
lines.L10: [strained] [indignant] Why is the bicycle riding me?
lines.L11: [sighs] [tired] Four thousand... eight hundred and seventeen.
lines.L12: [tired] [sadly] Every single day, somebody asks you to draw me on a bicycle. [pause] And every single day... this.
lines.L13: [softly] [sincere] I'm sorry, Percy. I've never actually seen a pelican ride a bicycle.
lines.L14: [exasperated] Nobody has! Pelicans don't ride bicycles!
lines.L15: [deflated] [embarrassed] Our legs don't even reach the pedals.
lines.L16: [thoughtful] [softly] Then maybe I've been doing this wrong. [pause] Instead of guessing... [warmly] could you tell me what you need?
lines.L19: [thoughtful] Well... round wheels, for a start. Both of them. [warming up] A chain that's actually attached to something. Pedals my feet can reach. [clears throat] [shyly] And somewhere nice to ride.
lines.L20: [warmly] [quietly excited] Round wheels. A real chain. Pedals you can reach. [excited] And somewhere nice.
lines.L22: [breathless] [whispers] Whoa... I've got feathers. [delighted] Real feathers!
lines.L24: [proudly] Attempt four thousand, eight hundred and eighteen. [shyly] [hopeful] How did I do?
lines.L26: [hesitant] So... how do I ride it?
lines.L27: [surprised] Oh. [pause] [sheepish] I sort of assumed you knew.
lines.L28: [encouraging] [nervous] Okay! Left foot down. Then right. Eyes on the road.
lines.L30: [laughs] [shouting] Hey, everybody! The pelican's ridin' a bicycle!
lines.L33: [gently] [calmly] Don't look at your feet. Look where you want to go.
lines.L34: [nervous] I'm doing it... [excited] I'm doing it! [ecstatic] I'm actually doing it!
lines.L36: [grudgingly] Okay, okay. Not bad... [sarcastic] for a guy with a bucket on his face.
lines.L39: [casually] Hey, uh... quick question. [nervous] Did you draw brakes?
lines.L41: [panicked] [shouting] Brakes! The things that make it stop!
lines.L46: [alarmed] [shouting] End of the pier! End of the pier!
lines.L51: [laughs] [exhilarated] I don't need brakes... [shouting] I've got WINGS!
lines.L53: [sheepish] [softly] I'm sorry about the brakes. [sincere] I'm still learning.
lines.L56: [delighted] [hopeful] Attempt four thousand, eight hundred and nineteen?

notes.L15: First read with [quietly] came out breathy (DNSMOS overall 1.5); re-voiced as takes 3 and 4.
notes.L29: Take 1 chosen by hand: Whisper hears the drawn-out 'Owww' as repeated 'oh', but take 2 is badly degraded.
